matt_csm: Quick weekly check-in for Clearway — token + throughput snapshot.

matt_csm: WoW tokens: -7.2% (1.14M -> 1.06M). QoQ tokens: +18.4% (890k -> 1.06M). Spend WoW: +12% (cost bump tied to model change last Wed).

kira_cs: Noted. Any specific time ranges where throughput dropped or latency spiked?

matt_csm: Yes — p50 latency steady ~95ms. p95 normally ~420ms but spiked to ~800ms between 13:17–13:24 UTC on Wed during a sustained batch of long-context requests. Error rate baseline 0.9% → bump to 1.8% during that window (mostly 5xx from runtime).

sam_eng: Thanks — those 13:17 traces show KV cache miss storms + autoscaler lag. I pushed a quick fix to reduce batch window for that pool (logs: ``/var/log/serving/clearway/2026-03-15.log``) and added a temporary fallback to the 13B variant.

harper_pm: Is the spend increase purely model size related or also due to retries from errors?

matt_csm: Mostly model switch (13B->33B) for a customer experiment, plus ~2% extra from retries during spike. Forecast if they keep 33B: monthly spend +38% QoQ.

kira_cs: Renewal risk: low today but calling this out — if spend stays up we should propose batching/caching + a staged rollback. Recommend enablement session next week to walk Clearway through caching and token budgeting.

sam_eng: Action items:
- sam_eng: verify autoscaler warm-up (owner)
- sam_eng: confirm prefix caching config applied (owner)
- kira_cs: schedule enablement w/ Clearway for Tuesday (owner)
- matt_csm: send high-level cost/quality tradeoff doc to customer (owner)

ops-bot: Incident note created: #INC-2418 (13:17 spike) — linked to clearway-account.

kira_cs: I'll coordinate time with CS playbook and include cost scenarios. :calendar:

matt_csm: Thanks — will follow up with the PO on whether they want to keep 33B for peak only. If so, propose scheduled hours for higher-tier model to control burn.

sam_eng: I'll monitor tomorrow's traffic window and report back. Short update by EOD.

matt_csm: Great, thanks all. End of thread.
